summary: First Busey Corporation filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 on October 13, 2026, announcing a quarterly cash dividend of $0.26 per share on its common stock, payable October 30, 2026 to holders of record October 23, 2026. The Leawood, Kansas bank holding company made no mention of any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, strategic review, or other special situation. The filing is signed by CFO Christopher H.M. Chan and contains only cover-page and XBRL exhibits. This is an ordinary capital-return declaration, not a special-situations event, so no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
